_comment: Grow Board settings. READ-ONLY - this app never writes to the POS database. The SQL password is deliberately NOT stored here: release builds are published publicly for auto-update. Enter it once on the Settings page; it is kept per-machine under %APPDATA%\Grow Board.

update._comment: Auto-update reads GitHub Releases at https://github.com/vikashpatel04/Grow-board/releases. Set enabled=false to switch updates off.
